name: papercusp-templates
description: Public mirror of the papercusp official templates (canonical: the papercup monorepo templates/ dir) as a RUNNABLE harness (WI-2862): `npm install && npm test` runs every <id>/checks/*.test.ts — composition-integrity executes UNCONFIGURED against the sibling template.yamls here; the app-parameterized checks (boot-e2e, components-integrated, ...) SKIP unless TEMPLATE_CHECKS_CONFIG names a checks-config JSON. @papercusp/template-kit resolves from the vendored ./template-kit dir (WI-2860); @papercusp/hive-app-seam from the vendored ./hive-app-seam dir (WI-2891). See README.md § Supply chain.
